name: Idle Hands
overview: Scripture warns against idleness by highlighting the consequences of slothfulness and the value of diligence. Proverbs encourages us to learn from the ant's industriousness and questions the sluggard about the length of his inactivity, emphasizing that laziness leads to poverty while diligent hands bring prosperity and leadership. The truth that "idle hands are the devil's playground" is reflected in the contrast between profitable labor and empty talk, as well as the destructive speech that arises from ungodliness. Thus, the Bible calls believers to embrace diligence as a reflection of godly wisdom and to avoid the pitfalls of idleness that can lead to sin.
